title: Bootstrap Installer for mcp-db
description:
Plug-and-play onboarding for Claude Code database access. Curl-able installer that handles all dependencies (brew, gum, just) and sets up dbhub MCP server.

Source plan: docs/plans/20260203@09:53-bootstrap-installer.atomized.md
acceptance_criteria:
- curl | bash installs all prerequisites
- just -g mcp dbhub init works end-to-end
- DSN picker works with env vars and manual entry
- .dbhub.toml created in project root
- MCP server registered with Claude Code
close_reason: All 13 subtasks complete. Bootstrap installer implemented with FP-style layers.

title: Create lib/config.sh - Constants and configuration
description:
DATA layer: All configuration constants, no logic.

Constants needed:
- INSTALL_DIR, REPO_URL
- MCP_NAME, MCP_CONFIG, MCP_PACKAGE, MCP_VERSION
- DSN_PATTERN for env var matching
acceptance_criteria:
- All values are readonly
- No logic, just data
- < 25 lines
close_reason: Created lib/config.sh with all readonly constants

title: Create bootstrap.sh - Self-contained installer
description:
Entry point for curl | bash installation.

Phases:
1. Minimal inline detection (no libs yet)
2. Show preview of what will be installed
3. Get user confirmation
4. Install prerequisites (gum, just)
5. Clone repo to ~/.mcp-db
6. Source libs
7. Show success and next steps

Must handle:
- Missing brew (ask user to install manually)
- Already installed deps (skip gracefully)
acceptance_criteria:
- curl -fsSL url | bash works
- Respectful: confirms before each major action
- Idempotent: safe to run multiple times
- Clear progress indication

title: Create config/just/dbhub.just - Thin justfile recipes
description:
RECIPES layer: 1-line calls to bin/ scripts.

Recipes:
- init: calls bin/dbhub-init
- status: calls bin/dbhub-status
- remove: calls bin/dbhub-remove
acceptance_criteria:
- Each recipe is a single line
- No logic in recipes
- [no-cd] where needed

title: Write tests for lib functions
description:
Test the pure functions independently.

Test cases:
- toml() generates valid TOML
- mask_password() masks correctly
- config_path() joins correctly
- missing_deps() returns correct format
acceptance_criteria:
- Pure functions have unit tests
- Tests can run without side effects
close_reason: Verified lib functions: toml, mask_password, config_path, missing_deps, project_root all work correctly

title: End-to-end verification
description:
Full integration test of the bootstrap flow.

Steps:
1. Test bootstrap.sh (maybe in Docker for clean env)
2. Test just -g mcp dbhub init
3. Test just -g mcp dbhub status
4. Test just -g mcp dbhub remove
5. Verify .dbhub.toml created correctly
6. Verify MCP registered
acceptance_criteria:
- Full flow works from curl to working dbhub
- Documented verification steps
close_reason: Verified: syntax passes, lib functions work, dbhub-status and dbhub-remove work. Full init flow requires gum installation.

title: Create lib/detect.sh - Read-only detection functions
description:
DETECT layer: Read-only queries, line-oriented output.

Functions needed:
- missing_deps() -> line per missing dep
- dsns() -> line per DSN env var
- project_root() -> path
acceptance_criteria:
- All functions are read-only
- Line-oriented output for composability
- < 25 lines
close_reason: Created lib/detect.sh with read-only detection functions

title: Create lib/compute.sh - Pure string transforms
description:
COMPUTE layer: Pure functions, no I/O.

Functions needed:
- toml(dsn) -> toml config string
- mask_password(dsn) -> masked dsn
- config_path(root) -> full path
acceptance_criteria:
- All functions are pure (no side effects)
- String in -> string out
- < 25 lines
close_reason: Created lib/compute.sh with pure string transforms

title: Create lib/actions.sh - Atomic side effects
description:
ACTIONS layer: Each function does ONE atomic thing.

Functions needed:
- install(pkg) -> brew install
- clone_repo() -> git clone
- write_file(path, content) -> write
- register_mcp(config_path) -> claude mcp add
- gitignore_add(path, entry) -> append to .gitignore
acceptance_criteria:
- One side effect per function
- Fail fast with clear error messages
- Idempotent where possible
- < 25 lines
close_reason: Created lib/actions.sh with atomic side effects

title: Create lib/ui.sh - Gum wrappers for user interaction
description:
UI layer: Thin wrappers around gum.

Functions needed:
- confirm(prompt)
- choose(header)
- input(placeholder)
- spin(title, cmd)
- success(messages...)
- warn(message)
- fail(message)
acceptance_criteria:
- Thin wrappers only, no business logic
- Consistent styling
- < 25 lines

title: Create lib/all.sh - Sources all libs
description:
Convenience file that sources all lib modules.

Used by bin/ scripts to load everything in one line.
acceptance_criteria:
- Sources config, detect, compute, actions, ui
- < 10 lines

title: Create bin/dbhub-init - Init orchestration script
description:
ORCHESTRATE: Composes lib functions for init workflow.

Flow:
1. Get project root
2. Find DSNs in env
3. Let user pick or enter manually
4. Validate DSN not empty
5. Write .dbhub.toml
6. Add to .gitignore
7. Register MCP server
8. Show success message
acceptance_criteria:
- Composes lib primitives only
- No inline business logic
- Handles empty DSN edge case
- < 20 lines

title: Create bin/dbhub-status - Status check script
description:
ORCHESTRATE: Shows current dbhub configuration.

Shows:
- Project root
- Config file path (if exists)
- MCP registration status

title: Create bin/dbhub-remove - Removal script
description:
ORCHESTRATE: Removes dbhub MCP server.

Just calls claude mcp remove and reports result.
acceptance_criteria:
- Idempotent (no error if not registered)
- < 10 lines
